QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tay] Booking a Singer
QuestInfo.0: A singer needs to be booked for the 9th Anniversary party. Go talk to Cassandra for the details.
QuestInfo.1: Blake is at the top of the list of singers to contact. #bBlake can be found at the Kerning Square Lobby#k. Go explain the situation to Blake and see if he'd be willing to perform at the party.
QuestInfo.2: You've successfully booked Blake to perform! The party preparations are shaping up!
